experiment: After first-victim position alternatives fail to seat the second victim, try each other allowed first-victim shape at its nearest legal position and reseat the second victim. Retain caller-owned shape/side restrictions, physical checks and actual work accounting. No extra pose enumeration per new shape.
recipe: Carrier 162x150 recipe in 2026-10-18-recovery-opportunity-screen.json, eight poses and 4096 frontier nodes, baseline plus granular-minor+vertical+estimator-first.

tests.limits: Existing rollback, geometry, determinism and work-accounting suite; not a dedicated acceptance witness for the added branch or full-board qualification.

decision: Revert the experiment: it executed additional shape work but recovered no additional pair and produced no smaller board. Do not turn this into default overhead on the evidence available.
next_direction: Investigate the incoming group's selected shape/pose in pair recovery; it is chosen before testing both displaced groups, and changing that upstream choice may be necessary. Existing results do not prove physical infeasibility.
